items.reason: Patients 'receive MBG453 and spartalizumab IV ... then undergo stereotactic radiosurgery on Day 8'. Manual §2 records all other antitumour drugs and radiotherapy in the experimental arm as partners. The registered intervention is MBG453, so spartalizumab (a second antibody) is its partner along with SRS.

note: Medium confidence only because the manual does not say whether a co-candidate in an experimental_combination counts as a 'partner'. Regimen = combination either way. MBG453 is kept as the development code (the record gives no INN, so the moiety is mapped by script later). D31-C2 now settles the partner question: co-candidates are included, so spartalizumab is listed as MBG453's partner.
